visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Three young creators, two women and one man, are seated on a white sofa in a brightly lit indoor room. Behind them is a large dark poster of the solar system decorated with small Christmas ornaments. They are wearing black hoodies and smiling broadly, waving and pointing at the camera to start their video. (2) A series of rapid cuts follow as the group plays a selection game. Circular portraits of famous male actors appear on the screen with "VS" labels. The creators react with dramatic facial expressions, pointing left or right to signify their choices. The lighting remains bright and consistent throughout the studio-like home setting. (3) The middle creator, a woman with two small buns in her hair, becomes particularly animated while talking about a specific actor. A promotional poster for a Netflix series titled "Had I Not Seen the Sun" appears in the center. Heart icons and pink color tones are added over her face to emphasize her crush. (4) The video switches to a screen recording of an Instagram story. A young man with short dark hair and a beige-and-brown jacket speaks directly to the camera. He is in a brightly lit indoor space. Subtitles in Chinese and English are visible at the bottom of the screen recording interface. (5) The scene returns to the three creators on the sofa. They are laughing hysterically. The woman on the left side of the screen suddenly stands up and runs out of the frame while the other two watch her, laughing. Variety show-style graphics like sweat drops and question marks appear near their heads.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy upbeat BGM starts. Three voices (2 female, 1 male) shout the game title in unison. Vocal arousal is at a maximum. A sharp metallic 'ding' SFX marks the end of the shout. BGM maintains a steady, fast tempo with electronic drum textures. (2) A male voice speaks actor names clearly as options. A short 'pop' SFX follows the visual change. Three voices shout a name with rising pitch and laughter. Another 'ding' SFX occurs. The vocal intensity is high. (3) The pattern of name listing, pop SFX, shouting, and ding SFX repeats several times. Laughter and high-pitched squeals from female voices increase the acoustic event density. The BGM beat remains regular and driving. (4) Transition to narration about a drama. A soft 'thud' SFX occurs. Female voices talk with high breathiness and an excited tone. SFX of a dog barking and a rhythmic heartbeat thump are integrated into the speech layer for emphasis. (5) BGM volume ducks significantly. A new male voice with a clear, deep timbre and professional broadcast clarity speaks. Background room tone is audible. No musical percussion is present in this segment. Vocal dominance is high. (6) BGM swells back to full volume. Loud laughter from the original group. A high-pitched cartoon 'whoosh' SFX accompanies a fast visual movement. Multiple voices overlap in a chaotic, joyful manner before the track cuts to silence.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Interaction Game -> Storytelling/Review -> Promotion -> Outro
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a popular 'Male God Choice' game to transition into a promotional review of the Netflix drama 'Had I Not Seen the Sun'. By showcasing the creators' genuine excitement and including a personal shout-out from the lead actor, it aims to drive viewership for the series.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct mention of the Netflix series, display of the official poster, and a customized promotional video message from actor Tseng Chin-hua.
